completion.heading: You did it!
completion.lead: Congratulations! You've completed Mastering the Silver Reed SK840.
paragraphs: You've worked through setting up your machine, automatic patterning, tuck, slip, Fair Isle, lace, your ribber, and more.
Most importantly, you've spent time getting to know **your machine**. Keep experimenting, practicing, and referring back to these lessons whenever you need a refresher.
